column1: # HAND-MAINTAINED. A record of human decisions, not generated data — nothing
# validate_data.py reports pairs of registry rows whose names are near-identical,
# because that is how one thing becomes two rows. Similarity cannot tell a typo
# from two genuinely different places: Silvarium and The Solarium are both in
# Solana and score highly, and they are not the same place.
# A row here asserts "these are two different entities and both rows should
# exist", and stops that pair being reported. There is no row for the opposite
# verdict — if the two are the same thing you merge them, and the pair no longer
# Delete a row if either id is merged away or renamed; validate_data.py reports
# entries naming an id that no longer exists, because a stale entry silently
# suppresses a real warning about the surviving row.

General Koda and General Ekoda are different characters. Koda held the bridge at Sworyuk Gorge and died of his wounds (weapons/merciless-battleaxe.md); reviewed 2026-09-26, confirmed distinct.

Carva and Corva are different characters. Carva is Blave's sibling, killed by Uzuri on main-story/outsiders/the-spiders-trap.md:78; Corva is the Biomancer named on world-of-rathe/demonastery.md:71. Reviewed 2026-09-26, confirmed distinct.
Lady Barthimont and Lord Barthimont are different characters — a married couple, both named on other-characters/lady-barthimont.md. Reviewed 2026-09-26, confirmed distinct.

Orien and Soren are different characters. Orien is Jarl Vetreiði's travelling companion on main-story/mastery-pack-guardian/trouble-in-larinkmorth.md:159; Soren is named on flavour/part-the-mistveil.md. Reviewed 2026-09-26, confirmed distinct.
